claim: The observed historical 3D Lotto and Lotto 6/42 results are broadly compatible with the fair-random processes tested in Phase 3.
supporting_evidence_for_review: Phase 3 verdict is PHASE3_PASS_RANDOM_COMPATIBLE; Phase 3 simulation diagnostics passed their structural and empirical-p checks.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: Compatibility applies only to tested diagnostics and histories; failure to reject tested random processes does not prove perfect randomness.
assumptions_for_jev: "The Phase 3 null generators and diagnostic family represent the relevant fair processes."
statistical_limitations_for_jev: "Finite histories and selected diagnostics limit power against subtle departures."
overstatement_risk: "Calling the draws proven fair or perfectly random would overstate the result."
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: Results were broadly compatible with the fair-random processes and diagnostics tested in Phase 3.
jev_recommended_wording: Results were broadly compatible with the fair-random processes and diagnostics tested in Phase 3.

claim: Expanding historical frequency for Lotto 6/42 showed a small statistically detectable mutual-information association in development data.
supporting_evidence_for_review: MI=0.00368 nats per candidate; permutation p=0.00370; BH q=0.02960 for 6/42 expanding historical frequency.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: Small effect; one adjusted diagnostic; discovery is within development evidence and does not by itself imply predictive value or independent replication.
assumptions_for_jev: Permutation scheme and diagnostic family adjustment match the prespecified Phase 5R analysis.
statistical_limitations_for_jev: Information estimate and significance are conditional on the tested features, data, and permutation design.
overstatement_risk: Equating statistical detection with useful or reproducible prediction would overstate the evidence.
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: A small adjusted mutual-information association was detected for 6/42 expanding frequency in development data; predictive value remains unestablished.
jev_recommended_wording: A small adjusted mutual-information association was detected for 6/42 expanding frequency in development data; predictive value remains unestablished.

claim: The detected 6/42 mutual-information association did not translate into improved complete-combination probability scoring on chronological validation.
supporting_evidence_for_review: 6/42 raw NLL 15.49795 versus fair 15.47294; log-score advantage -0.02502; MC p=0.86701. 3D raw NLL 5.32132 versus fair 5.31989; advantage -0.00143; MC p=0.48555.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: The 3D paired 95% interval [-0.00535, 0.00252] crosses zero; the 6/42 interval [-0.04421, -0.00619] indicates worse score for the candidate under the reported sign convention.
assumptions_for_jev: The complete-combination likelihood is the relevant primary score and positive advantage favors the non-fair model.
statistical_limitations_for_jev: These are chronological validation results; validation was already inspected in Phase 5A.
overstatement_risk: Describing the MI result as a demonstrated combination predictor would overstate the evidence.
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: The detected MI association did not produce improved complete-combination validation likelihood over the fair baseline.
jev_recommended_wording: The detected MI association did not produce improved complete-combination validation likelihood over the fair baseline.

claim: The Phase 5A machine-learning candidates did not establish reliable predictive improvement over the relevant fair and historical baselines.
supporting_evidence_for_review: Phase 5A verdict is PHASE5A_INCONCLUSIVE; its advancement gate required proper score, baseline comparisons, fold consistency, bootstrap, and calibration evidence.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: Phase 5A validation was used for candidate assessment and is not pristine final-test confirmation; a few secondary point estimates can look favorable.
assumptions_for_jev: The predefined advancement gate and baseline definitions are appropriate for the research question.
statistical_limitations_for_jev: Model and candidate scope is finite; inconclusive validation does not establish zero signal.
overstatement_risk: Stating that all conceivable models have been ruled out would overstate the finite search.
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: Phase 5A candidates did not establish reliable improvement over the tested baselines on chronological validation.
jev_recommended_wording: Phase 5A candidates did not establish reliable improvement over the tested baselines on chronological validation.

claim: Bayesian shrinkage reduced some historical-frequency overfitting but still failed to outperform the fair-random complete-combination likelihood baseline.
supporting_evidence_for_review: Shrinkage brought some point estimates closer to fair; 6/42 beta kappa=1000 had log-score advantage -0.00977 and 3D Dirichlet kappa=1000 had -0.00109.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: All reported non-fair complete-combination point estimates remained at or below the fair baseline; 6/42 hits@6=0.90 is secondary to full-combination likelihood.
assumptions_for_jev: The shrinkage priors and concentration values are interpreted as evaluated in the Phase 5R report.
statistical_limitations_for_jev: Concentration choices and validation reuse constrain generalization; score differences are validation-only.
overstatement_risk: Saying shrinkage demonstrated predictive improvement from hit count alone would overstate proper-score results.
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: Shrinkage reduced some frequency-model overfit but did not beat fair-random complete-combination likelihood on validation.
jev_recommended_wording: Shrinkage reduced some frequency-model overfit but did not beat fair-random complete-combination likelihood on validation.

claim: No tested model currently satisfies the evidentiary standard required to justify opening the locked test partition.
supporting_evidence_for_review: Phase 5A and 5R reports retain the test gate; no model established the required validation improvement. Phase 5A says test targets were not parsed or scored; Phase 5R records locked test rows were not parsed or scored.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: The test partition has prospective value only if a model and analysis plan are frozen beforehand; repeated access would consume that value.
assumptions_for_jev: The existing advancement gate remains applicable and no separately approved test-opening authorization exists.
statistical_limitations_for_jev: Evidence about readiness comes from development/validation, not test outcomes.
overstatement_risk: An assertion that the test has no scientific value under any future design would overstate the present gate decision.
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: Current evidence does not justify opening the locked test; keep it sealed pending a frozen model and separately authorized evaluation.
jev_recommended_wording: Current evidence does not justify opening the locked test; keep it sealed pending a frozen model and separately authorized evaluation.

claim: The strongest evidence-supported conclusion is that no reproducible predictive signal has been detected under the available data and tested methods.
supporting_evidence_for_review: No candidate beat fair-random complete-combination likelihood; temporal intervals crossed zero; no stationarity change point passed BH; Phase 5A and 5R remained inconclusive.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: One small adjusted 6/42 MI association exists; available methods and history are finite, and development/validation are not an independent replication.
assumptions_for_jev: A non-detection conclusion is scoped to the tested methods and data; MI is treated separately from actionable prediction.
statistical_limitations_for_jev: Finite sample power, multiple analysis choices, and prior validation exposure limit claims of reproducibility.
overstatement_risk: Unqualified claims that no signal exists or prediction is impossible would overstate the evidence.
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: No reproducible predictive improvement was demonstrated under the available data and tested methods; this does not establish that prediction is impossible.
jev_recommended_wording: No reproducible predictive improvement was demonstrated under the available data and tested methods; this does not establish that prediction is impossible.

claim: The evidence does not prove that prediction is theoretically impossible.
supporting_evidence_for_review: The prior phases test a bounded set of processes and methods; the task interpretation rules explicitly distinguish non-detection from impossibility.
contradicting_or_cautionary_evidence_for: No finite empirical study can rule out every possible data-generating process or future method.
assumptions_for_jev: The claim is limited to the logical scope of the available experiments.
statistical_limitations_for_jev: The conclusion concerns bounded data and methods, not a universal impossibility theorem.
overstatement_risk: Extending the evidence to impossibility or certainty would be an unsupported universal claim.
recommended_wording_for_jev_review: Candidate wording only: These results do not establish that prediction is theoretically impossible.
jev_recommended_wording: These results do not establish that prediction is theoretically impossible.
